LESSON: TRANS SAHARAN SLAVE TRADE

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Relationships
Topic 3.3: Trans Saharan Slave Trade

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Trans Saharan Slave Trade
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why do people subject others to slave trade?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify factors that led to development of Trans- Saharan slave Trade in Africa
2. describe organisation of Trans-Saharan slave trade in Africa
3. demonstrate assertiveness in promotion of social justice
